classification: legacy-propagation compatibility snapshot with converged-order finite-Floquet atomic response
change_reason: The trace-normalized atomic density matrix already supplies the ground-manifold population, so the external macroscopic factor changed from p_F/12 to 1/12. The 100 kHz ground-coherence floor is now a trace-preserving thermal transit reset, while the density-dependent collision term remains pure dephasing. The atomic response changed from the fixed N_F=1 three-mode solve to N_F=3 with a full-scan N_F=2 comparison. No hidden refit of the inherited 0.74 residual was made.
